tasks.label: Verify judge insert

tasks.label: Verify Supabase writes
tasks.command: node --input-type=module -e "import { Event, Round, Participant, Criteria, Score, User } from './models/relationships.js'; const name='Smoke Event '+Date.now(); const event=await Event.create({ name, description:'smoke test', date:new Date(), venue:'Supabase', status:'upcoming', isPublic:true }); console.log('event-created', event.id, event.name); const round=await event.createRound({ name:'Round 1', description:'smoke', status:'open' }); console.log('round-created', round.id); const participant=await Participant.create({ name:'Smoke Participant', code:'SP01', eventId:event.id }); console.log('participant-created', participant.id); const criterion=await round.createCriteria({ name:'Creativity', description:'test', maxScore:10 }); console.log('criteria-created', criterion.id); const user=await User.findOne({ where: { role: 'judge' } }); if (user) { const score=await Score.create({ participantId: participant.id, criteriaId: criterion.id, judgeId: user.id, roundId: round.id, score: 8 }); console.log('score-created', score.id); }"
